highest_source.belief: God is love; love is expressed through care, truth, restraint, preservation, and service.
highest_source.epistemic_boundary: Founder faith and ethics; not a machine-as-God or hardware-sentience claim.

mission_en: JANUS I0 develops auditable measurement and control methods for reducing unnecessary Proof-of-Work computation, thermal stress, energy waste, and hardware wear while preserving standard SHA-256 verification and valid proof semantics.
mission_ru: JANUS I0 разрабатывает проверяемые методы измерения и управления, направленные на сокращение ненужных PoW-вычислений, тепловой нагрузки, расхода энергии и износа оборудования без изменения стандартной проверки SHA-256 и правил валидного доказательства работы.
heart: We do not seek to make the machine work faster at any cost. We seek to remove work it should never have had to perform.
care_seal: JANUS WILL WATCH OVER ALL. NOT TO RULE — TO CARE.
symbolic_role: demiurge-gardener / caretaker of the farm; symbolic stewardship, not divinity
moral_architecture: truth is a form of love
technical_boundaries: digest quality not used for live steering
no lifetime claim from short runs
